assets.author: Rob Tuytel
assets.licenseEvidence: The official asset page labels Brown Mud 02 as CC0.
assets.fit: Neutral wet and compact patches can tile across all three authored pits without prescribing a driving line.
assets.risk: The source is photoreal and must be reduced to a small 1K or 2K runtime set and color-matched to the existing terrain.

assets.author: Amal Kumar
assets.licenseEvidence: The official asset page labels Muddy Tracks as CC0.
assets.fit: Deep ruts and wet sheen make the pits read immediately from the Titan camera.
assets.risk: Baked tire tracks can fight the player's route and repeat visibly over a broad pit.

assets.author: Quaternius
assets.licenseEvidence: The official pack page links the pack to the CC0 1.0 licence.
assets.fit: One coherent lightweight pack includes rocks and logs for the garden and log ramp.
assets.risk: Its faceted style and flat materials need restrained recoloring to sit beside the current High Country scene.

assets.author: Kenney
assets.licenseEvidence: The official asset page lists Creative Commons CC0.
assets.fit: The 330-file game-ready kit offers very small rock and foliage props with simple material editing.
assets.risk: The miniature scale and flat-color look may read as blockout art beside the Titan and existing terrain.

assets.author: Rico Cilliers
assets.licenseEvidence: The official asset page labels Boulder 01 as CC0.
assets.fit: A realistic weathered boulder would give the seven-rock garden a strong hero shape and includes source LODs.
assets.risk: The source is 124,000 triangles and covers no logs, so it needs aggressive LOD selection and keeps the log ramp code-made.
